lessons.title: Greetings & introductions
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of greetings & introductions and apply it accurately to unfamiliar tasks.
lessons.core_teaching_content: Spoken Hindi development combines usable vocabulary, sentence patterns, listening, pronunciation and confidence. Learn phrases in meaningful situations rather than isolated word lists. Spoken grammar should support clear communication, while pronunciation practice focuses on intelligibility and listening discrimination. Focus specifically on greetings & introductions. Identify the key concepts, common errors, evidence or performance criteria required, and a repeatable method for improvement. Move from recognition to application: understand the task, perform it carefully, check against the stated criteria, and record the reason for any error.
examples: A Spoken Hindi Challenge task on greetings & introductions should begin by identifying the exact clue, form or performance criterion being tested.
Create a new greetings & introductions example with a plausible distractor or common error, then explain the correct response or performance.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused Spoken Hindi Challenge activity on greetings & introductions using practice questions, a text, oral dialogue, puzzle, writing sample or performance sample as appropriate.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on greetings & introductions: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent performance on the third with explicit justification or self-check.
independent_practice: Complete three unfamiliar greetings & introductions tasks without viewing the solution first.
Create one new example and complete it using the lesson method.
Review one error or weak performance and state the correction rule.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item Spoken Hindi Challenge checkpoint on greetings & introductions; target at least six correct or meet the stated performance standard consistently.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished Spoken Hindi Challenge task demonstrating greetings & introductions and record the evidence or self-assessment used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach for precise terminology, evidence and repeatable self-correction. Encourage independent performance before intervention. Suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one recurring error and one concrete action for improving greetings & introductions.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
